title: Vanilla Update
description: A modpack that enhances Minecraft's vanilla experience.
body:
![Vanilla Update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c77672b781530381e1213cac4f9c08f6c6cc54c.png)
##   What is it?
  **Vanilla Update** is the perfect modpack for those who love the vanilla Minecraft experience but want to add a touch of freshness and beauty to the familiar world.

## ✨ What’s inside:
 
###  -   **Optimization:** 
Improved performance for smooth gameplay, even on lower-end systems.
   
###  -   **Aesthetics:** 
Resource packs that update textures and visual effects while keeping the original Minecraft style intact.
   
###  -   **Gameplay Enhancements:** 
Subtle tweaks to make the game more enjoyable without disrupting its balance.
   
###  -   **Shaders:** 
A vanilla-friendly shader that adds soft lighting and atmosphere, like the cherry on top!

   **📦 This modpack retains the spirit of vanilla while enhancing every aspect of the game — from graphics to performance. It's perfect for long adventures or simply enjoying the sights of your favorite Minecraft world.**
